listings.title: NNA Half Round Bay Rd
listings.description: Positioned above the sparkling waters of Lake Coeur d'Alene, this 3.09-acre secondary waterfront parcel offers the perfect blend of privacy, access, and breathtaking views in sought-after Half Round Bay. Towering timber and gently rolling terrain frame stunning lake and mountain vistas--an ideal setting for your North Idaho dream home. The standout feature is the gated, shared community waterfront with over 250 feet of shoreline, providing easy access to one of the lake's most peaceful bays--perfect for boating, swimming, and relaxing days on the water. With a roughed-in driveway and utilities available at the property line, building is made simple. Enjoy a prime location just minutes from Highway 97 and within easy reach of I-90--plus quick boat access to Harrison, the Coeur d'Alene Resort, and Rockford Bay. A rare opportunity to own acreage with lake views and true waterfront access.
